reviews.author: Jennifer J
reviews.text: Very grateful I found Chris. I've been going to him for a few years now and appreciate not only the great service, but the desire to make sure customers are saving money when possible. Communication is is smooth. He flexes with my busy work schedule for drop-off and pickup and manages to work me into his schedule when I'm in between travels. I've recommended him to folks I know and will continue to do so

reviews.author: Whitney DiFronzo
reviews.text: I always receive great service from CBA!!! The staff is friendly, efficient, and professional. I appreciated Zeke going the extra mile to take care of the issue with my vehicle! He managed to fix the problem and come in under the bid. I highly recommend CBA.

reviews.author: Vance Ferrigno
reviews.text: The AC compressor in my Nissan went out and Chris took care of it for me. He is trustworthy and reasonably priced. I highly recommend anyone looking for a good local mechanic to give him a call.

reviews.author: Danielle LaPlume
reviews.text: Twice now Chris has able to quickly and effectively get my car in for repairs. I am a college student away from home, and he has been extremely helpful both times. I have had a flawless experience here, and I am extremely grateful.

reviews.author: Andy Zuidema
reviews.text: The last work I had done on my 2005 GMC 2500 by CBA was well over two years ago. I had an issue today totally unrelated to the work done and I sent Chris a text for help. He picked up the phone and called me 5 minutes later. Helped me with my issue. Now that is great customer service! I will always use CBA Automotive!

reviews.author: Mike Andrade
reviews.text: Chris has worked on all my automobiles 6 in total, from engine replacement to breaks to wiper blades, great work at a great price!

reviews.author: Eric Daniels
reviews.text: I could fix a Lamborghini with chewing gum!!! We love you, Chris, thank you for always being so kind!
